description:
All your AI subscription limits in one liquid-glass tray popover.

Pane shows how much of your session and weekly limits each AI tool has left,
directly from the Windows system tray. It auto-detects the CLIs and apps you
already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Grok and more - 18
providers), projects whether you will run out before the reset, computes
local spend with live model pricing, and updates itself via signed releases.
No telemetry; tokens only ever go to their own vendor's API.
What's Changed
- Make the key-rotation tests deterministic under the parallel runner by @LJC-god in #213
- Support mainland Zhipu (bigmodel.cn) keys on the GLM card by @ItsJazii in #219
- Report real fetch times and universal freshness in the local HTTP API by @ItsJazii in #220
- Discover extra OpenCode profiles and drop stale cache after an auth swap by @ItsJazii in #221
- Add a minimal view — one starred meter per card by @ItsJazii in #222
- Stop the spend scan from re-reading gigabytes of session logs by @ItsJazii in #223
- Release 0.4.51 by @ItsJazii in #224
Full Changelog: v0.4.50...v0.4.51
